text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

NOVA MAKEDONIJA - Macedonia has raised its combat readiness at its border with Albania and the junction of three borders towards Yugoslavia and Greece. Macedonia is concered by the situation in the neighbouring country and possible exodus of refugees and criminals.

- Fourteen students from Teachers' academy started a hunger strike in front of the Macedonian parliament. At least 2,000 demonstrators protested Tuesday in Skopje against the new law on use of national minorities' languages in the academy.

- The PDPA party (ethnic Albanians) that won local elections in western Macedonia will carry out regionalisation projects in this part of the country in order to fulfil the needs of Albanian majority.
